summary: This task is a root-cause-analysis (RCA) exercise for a stalled sibling task (task-20260726-171946), not a code change: the branch HEAD is byte-identical to origin/master (zero commits ahead, empty diff, clean working tree), confirming the worker's own conclusion that this was a genuine no-op for the repository. The RCA itself is well-supported (journalctl showing the unit killed by the kernel's system-wide OOM killer, free -h and ATTENTION.md corroborating memory exhaustion across ~15-30 concurrent worker units) and the fix applied -- adding MemoryHigh/MemoryMax/MemorySwapMax to the host's systemd unit template -- is correctly scoped outside any repo since it is host infrastructure, not application code, and the worker verified no existing repo tracks that unit file. There is nothing in this diff that touches .github/workflows/**, migrations, auth, or any other tier2-triggering path, and no architecture, correctness, or security concerns arise because no code was changed.
issues: The applied systemd fix (MemoryHigh=2G/MemoryMax=3G/MemorySwapMax=1G on veridian-worker@.service) lives only on the live host and is not captured in any repo/IaC, so it will be lost on host rebuild -- worth a follow-up to codify it, though not a blocker for this no-op task.
